diff --git a/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py b/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
index e7dbd5d..8e5daca 100644
--- a/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
+++ b/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
@@ -122,6 +122,78 @@ def test_no_webengine_available(monkeypatch, config_stub, parser, stubs):
     assert args == [sys.argv[0]]
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('locale, expected', [
+    ('es_MX', 'es-MX.pak'),
+    ('zh-HK', 'zh-HK.pak'),
+])
+def test_locale_pak_path(tmp_path, locale, expected):
+    assert qtargs._get_locale_pak_path(str(tmp_path), locale) == str(tmp_path / expected)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('locale, expected', [
+    ('en', 'en-US'), ('en-LR', 'en-US'), ('en-PH', 'en-US'),
+    ('en-AU', 'en-GB'), ('en-CA', 'en-GB'),
+    ('en-IE', 'en-GB'), ('en-IN', 'en-GB'), ('en-NZ', 'en-GB'),
+    ('en-ZA', 'en-GB'), ('en-ZW', 'en-GB'),
+    ('es', 'es-419'), ('es-MX', 'es-419'), ('es-ES', 'es'),
+    ('pt', 'pt-BR'),
+    ('zh', 'zh-CN'),
+    ('zh-HK', 'zh-TW'), ('zh-MO', 'zh-TW'),
+])
+def test_lang_override_mappings(tmp_path, config_stub, monkeypatch, locale, expected):
+    config_stub.val.qt.workarounds.locale = True
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.utils, 'is_linux', True)
+    (tmp_path / (expected + '.pak')).touch()
+    versions = version.WebEngineVersions.from_pyqt('5.15.3')
+    assert qtargs._get_lang_override(versions, locale, str(tmp_path)) == expected
+
+
+def test_lang_override_fallbacks(tmp_path, config_stub, monkeypatch):
+    config_stub.val.qt.workarounds.locale = True
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.utils, 'is_linux', True)
+    versions = version.WebEngineVersions.from_pyqt('5.15.3')
+    (tmp_path / 'fr.pak').touch()
+    assert qtargs._get_lang_override(versions, 'fr_CA', str(tmp_path)) == 'fr'
+    assert qtargs._get_lang_override(versions, 'es_MX', str(tmp_path)) == 'en-US'
+    (tmp_path / 'es.pak').touch()
+    assert qtargs._get_lang_override(versions, 'es_MX', str(tmp_path)) == 'es'
+    (tmp_path / 'es-MX.pak').touch()
+    assert qtargs._get_lang_override(versions, 'es_MX', str(tmp_path)) is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('locale', ['en-GB', 'pt-BR', 'pt-PT', 'zh-CN', 'zh-TW'])
+def test_lang_override_existing_pak(tmp_path, config_stub, monkeypatch, locale):
+    config_stub.val.qt.workarounds.locale = True
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.utils, 'is_linux', True)
+    (tmp_path / (locale + '.pak')).touch()
+    versions = version.WebEngineVersions.from_pyqt('5.15.3')
+    assert qtargs._get_lang_override(versions, locale, str(tmp_path)) is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('enabled, linux, qt_version', [
+    (False, True, '5.15.3'), (True, False, '5.15.3'),
+    (True, True, '5.15.2'), (True, True, '5.15.4'),
+])
+def test_lang_override_gates(tmp_path, config_stub, monkeypatch,
+                             enabled, linux, qt_version):
+    config_stub.val.qt.workarounds.locale = enabled
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.utils, 'is_linux', linux)
+    versions = version.WebEngineVersions.from_pyqt(qt_version)
+    assert qtargs._get_lang_override(versions, 'es_MX', str(tmp_path)) is None
+
+
+def test_lang_override_argument(tmp_path, config_stub, monkeypatch, parser,
+                                version_patcher):
+    version_patcher('5.15.3')
+    config_stub.val.qt.workarounds.locale = True
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.utils, 'is_linux', True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.QLibraryInfo, 'location', lambda _: str(tmp_path))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.QLocale, 'system', lambda: qtargs.QLocale('es_MX'))
+    (tmp_path / 'qtwebengine_locales').mkdir()
+    (tmp_path / 'qtwebengine_locales' / 'es-419.pak').touch()
+    assert '--lang=es-419' in qtargs.qt_args(parser.parse_args([]))
+
+
 @pytest.mark.usefixtures('reduce_args')
